references.context: Plunge through the flashing LAB lane or the flashing rank lane. Then shoot the right mission saucer to start the first mission.
references.label: Mission saucer
references.description: The mission start is on the upper-right side, below the right wireform.

references.context: Between missions, hit the A-I-R targets and shoot the left loop for locks. Finish any running mission before you take the third lock.
references.label: A-I-R targets
references.description: The A-I-R bank is in the upper-left area beside the hangar entrance.

references.context: Between missions, hit the A-I-R targets and shoot the left loop for locks. Finish any running mission before you take the third lock.
references.label: Air Strike lock loop
references.description: The left loop enters the upper-left hangar and feeds the ball lock.

references.context: While the Air Strike ball save runs, attack the center tank. If Methane is ready, hit the blue tank target for the one-shot kill. Otherwise, damage the tank only while the extra balls protect the reject.
references.label: Tank target
references.description: The tank and its attack target are in the center of the upper playfield.

references.context: Start Air Strike Multiball with the third left-loop lock. Shoot both orbits, the left ramp, and the mission saucer for Jackpots. Then shoot the moving UFO for the Super Jackpot.
references.label: Moving UFO
references.description: The moving UFO target crosses the upper-middle playfield.

references.context: Make 36 pop-bumper hits to start the first Meltdown Multiball.
references.label: Pop bumpers and QA banks
references.description: The pop bumpers and hidden QA target banks are at the top of the playfield.
